summary.intent: Fix two Claude Code hook failures (blank statusline and noisy Stop-hook error), update GSD to 1.6.0, clean up stale worktrees, then autonomously plan and execute Phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT) of the v2.0 milestone.
summary.outcome: All hook failures resolved, GSD updated to 1.6.0, 3 worktrees removed, and Phase 61 fully implemented and verified: 5 plans across 4 waves, 17 commits, 196 TS + 97 Rust tests green, cross-language KAT byte-pinned TS↔Rust, parity CI registered, ADR 0003 frozen, phase marked complete.

repo: The repo has `"type": "module"` in package.json, which causes Node to treat all `.js` files as ESM — hooks using CommonJS `require()` must use the `.cjs` extension to override this.
GSD hooks are gitignored via `.gitignore:55` pattern `gsd-*`, so they are regenerated per-clone via the installer and cannot be restored by git.

The main-tree GSD install can be a broken fragment (missing gsd-tools.cjs, gsd-file-manifest.json, most workflows) while worktrees have a complete install — the authoritative fix is `npx @opengsd/gsd-core@<ver> -- gsd-core --claude --local`.

scripts/check-vector-parity.sh has a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` bash array; adding any new vector JSON file requires a matching entry or the CI parity step fails even when both Rust and TS tests pass.
vitest is configured with `include: ['src/**/*.ts']` in `packages/crypto` — test files outside `src/` are silently ignored and never discovered.
scripts/tsconfig.scripts.json requires `@types/node` but the package is not hoisted to root `node_modules/@types/` — pre-existing environment issue unrelated to crypto changes.

1Password SSH agent requires biometric approval per commit, which deadlocks autonomous/AFK execution sessions; commit signing must be disabled locally (`git config commit.gpgsign false`) before unattended runs.

Wave 4 of Phase 61 had planned parallel execution of 61-04 (Rust) and 61-05 (docs) with zero file overlap — but worktrees were disabled because Waves 1–3 share `node-aad.json` sequentially and vitest requires `node_modules`.

code.finding: Correct test path — CONTEXT.md and ROADMAP erroneously cited `packages/crypto/__tests__/` (outside vitest include glob), which would silently skip the KAT. Planner was corrected by the research subagent.
Contains a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` array; `tests/vectors/crypto/node-aad.json` had to be explicitly added in plan 61-01 or the parity CI step fails.
The fixed-IV KAT must target `encryptAesGcmAad` (caller-supplied IV), not `sealAesGcmAad` (which mints a fresh random IV each call and cannot produce a reproducible test vector).

The `uuid` crate (v1.23.4) was not present before Phase 61; it is the only new workspace dependency introduced and requires additions to both the root `Cargo.toml` workspace and the crate-level `Cargo.toml`.

TS KAT originally iterated `aad_vectors` with a `for...of` loop but had no array-length assertion — an empty array passes vacuously. Hardened by adding `expect(vectors.aad_vectors).toHaveLength(4)` plus role-set assertion `[1,2,3,4]`.
Same vacuous-pass hole for `seal_vectors` TS KAT — no length guard despite Rust side asserting `!seal_vectors.is_empty()`. Hardened with `expect(vectors.seal_vectors.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)`.

Project settings override the global statusLine; previously pointed at `statusline.js` which crashed as ESM. Updated to `statusline.cjs` after rename. GSD 1.6.0 local install skips statusLine, preserving this custom hook.
Wires `gsd-context-monitor.js` into four hook events including Stop — this file is gitignored and must exist on disk (installed by GSD) or every turn produces a MODULE_NOT_FOUND error.

workflow: GSD plan-phase does NOT auto-commit PATTERNS.md after the pattern-mapper runs — it must be committed explicitly by the orchestrator before the planner is spawned.

The `gsd-tools update-state` helper can false-negative, returning `updated: []` even when STATE.md was modified. Always verify with `git status` or `git diff` rather than trusting the helper's return value.
The GSD commit helper also false-negatives (reports failure) but the commit actually lands — always verify with `git log` after a reported commit failure before attempting a retry.

The adversarial multi-lens verification workflow (ultracode) caught two critical vacuous-pass holes in the plans before execution that the canonical plan-checker alone would have missed — valuable for crypto where silent failures are catastrophic.

Worktrees should be disabled when sequential waves share a mutable file (e.g., `node-aad.json` written in wave 1, read in wave 2) or when subagents need warm `node_modules` for vitest — the parallelism benefit is outweighed by coordination complexity.

For AFK autonomous sessions, disabling commit signing locally (`git config commit.gpgsign false`) is necessary when using 1Password SSH agent, but PRs opened afterward may show unsigned-commit warnings that require manual re-signing.

friction: GSD plan-phase silently skips committing PATTERNS.md despite the workflow implying it should be handled — required a manual commit step the workflow documentation doesn't make explicit.
The `gsd-tools update-state` helper repeatedly false-negatived (reported `updated: []`) even when STATE.md was actually modified, requiring manual intervention to hand-edit and re-commit STATE.md.
Every git commit during the AFK session false-negatived from the commit helper, requiring a `git log` verification step after each one — added latency across 17+ commits.
1Password SSH commit signing deadlocks autonomous sessions requiring biometric approval; requires proactive detection and `git config commit.gpgsign false` before any unattended run.

The GSD main-tree install was silently broken (fragment only) while worktree installs were complete — no clear signal until the Stop hook errored, and the fix required a full reinstall rather than targeted file restore.

CONTEXT.md for Phase 61 had an incorrect test path (`packages/crypto/__tests__/`) that would have caused the KAT to be silently ignored by vitest — only caught by the research subagent, not by any static validation.
open_items: Phase 61 branch needs `/ship-phase` run — execution completed and phase marked complete but ship-phase was not launched before the transcript ended.
Commits from this AFK session were made without GPG/SSH signatures (`git config commit.gpgsign false`); the PR may show unsigned-commit warnings and may need a rebase + re-sign before merge.
Git branches `fix/phase60-safety-tail` and `fix/fuse-delete-share-revocation` still exist after their worktrees were removed — may be stale branches worth pruning.
Pre-existing `@types/node` resolution failure in `scripts/tsconfig.scripts.json` — v20 is in pnpm store but not hoisted to root `node_modules/@types/`; blocks full root typecheck chain.
Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec) is next in the v2.0 milestone and is currently `· Up next` (gated on Phase 61 which is now complete).

`node-aad.json` currently contains `aad_vectors` only (4 role vectors from wave 1) — the `seal_vectors` key was added in wave 3 (61-03); worth confirming the final file structure has both keys before shipping.

The GSD manager was initialized but the session pivoted to direct plan/execute invocations — the manager loop was not resumed after execution completed; `completed_count` in the manager dashboard still shows stale state until next `/gsd-manager` invocation.
